episodes.synopsis: Akane copes with her trauma by being popular and working hard to make people like her, but one boy in her class doesn’t care about her at all. That bothers her to no end.
episodes.title: The Hated Classmate

episodes.synopsis: Reincarnated as the son of Baron Kagenou, Cid bides his time as Background Character A while preparing for the day he can finally become the Eminence in Shadow!
episodes.title: Shadow Garden Is Born

episodes.synopsis: The princess is supposed to reject the background character’s confession, not accept it — since when did Cid become a rom-com protagonist?
episodes.title: Fencer Ordinaire

episodes.synopsis: The mistake those with power always make is believing that they are the ones in control.
episodes.title: Sadism's Rewards

episodes.synopsis: Cid is not facing a minion but a would-be Knight of the Rounds. Normally, that is cause for concern, but an atomic bomb has no reason to fear the gnashing of a lowly pest.
episodes.title: I Am...

episodes.synopsis: While Iris seeks a bright mind to study an artifact, Cid visits a popular store. Meanwhile, in the dark corners of the city, someone commits murders in Shadow Garden’s name!
episodes.title: Pretenders

episodes.synopsis: Cid gets a report from Nu about powerful cult members lurking in the Royal Capital. Too bad he’s too distracted about the upcoming fencing tournament to notice.
episodes.title: A Fencing Tournament of Intrigue and Bloodshed

episodes.synopsis: Cid sacrificed his life to save Rose. At least, that’s what everyone thinks. Unbeknownst to anyone else, Cid survived exactly as planned, and now his counterattack can begin.
episodes.title: Dark Knight Academy Under Attack

episodes.synopsis: When the students fight back, Shadow Garden joins the fray as their reinforcements. Amidst the chaos, Cid confronts the Gaunt Knight.
episodes.title: The End of a Lie

episodes.synopsis: Cid heads to Lindwurm in response to a summons from Alpha, but he is not the only one traveling there; the annual Goddess’ Trial is quickly approaching.
episodes.title: The Sacred Land, City of Deception

episodes.synopsis: The curtain rises on the Goddess’ Trial. When Cid is unwittingly called into the arena, he transforms into Shadow and faces none other than Aurora, the Witch of Calamity.
episodes.title: The Goddess' Trial

episodes.synopsis: The door to the Sanctuary opens and Alpha strides through it, intending to expose the Cult’s grave secrets. Meanwhile, Cid also enters the Sanctuary and reunites with… Aurora?
episodes.title: The Truth Within the Memories

episodes.synopsis: Alpha faces off against an empowered Nelson in a vicious battle. Elsewhere, Cid and Aurora reach the Sanctuary's core, but a door only a hero can open blocks their path.
episodes.title: A Bloody Showdown as an Offering to Annihilation

episodes.synopsis: Cid’s victory is short-lived when Nelson counters with his new magic. Meanwhile, Alexia convinces Rose and Natsume to form an alliance to uncover the truth of their world.
episodes.title: Your Lie, Your Wish

episodes.synopsis: Only the strongest warriors can advance in the prestigious Bushin Festival, but one contestant proves himself a feeble and mundane man with no talent. Why is he competing?
episodes.title: The Strongest Weakest Man

episodes.synopsis: Princess Rose flees to the north of the Royal Capital. The Oriana Kingdom wants to handle it internally as a “purely domestic” matter.
episodes.title: Unseen Intentions

episodes.synopsis: Cid recollects piano lessons from his past life — what impact does this have on his present? Meanwhile, Epsilon’s performance sets the soundtrack for something else...
episodes.title: Moonlight That Pierces the Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Cid and Claire receive an invitation to a tournament. At the festivities, Cid receives more attention than a background character desires.
episodes.title: Betting on a Moment

episodes.synopsis: Doem tries to make war with Midgar. Meanwhile, the match between Jimina and Iris begins.
episodes.title: Dancing Puppet

episodes.synopsis: Provoked by the fight between Shadow and Beatrix, Iris joins the fray. An intense battle progresses across the Royal Capital. Meanwhile, Rose runs into Alpha...
episodes.title: Advent of the Demon
